look: Evidence in motion: premium cinematic mission-control look for executives, digital-service users, governance and technical teams. Dramatic Titillium Web typography, elegant depth and parallax, precise easing, moving evidence threads, warm-white evidence sheets, meaningful diagram reveals, amber for review. Genuine PolicyWatcher logo, never redrawn. Main text >=48px, labels >=28px. No fake screenshots, invented metrics or certification. Ten scenes timed exactly to story.json for later narration sync; end card reserves three stationary QR slots for the last 15 s.

scenes.name: The rules change
scenes.desc: Two neutral policy passages; one changed line resolves from a field of text; the eye/shield mark reveals.

scenes.name: Clearer decision
scenes.desc: Source, version, change and evidence join into one path; brand mark and product 5.5.

scenes.name: Two environments
scenes.desc: Stable public service and private Engine 6 Preview run in parallel under one mission, with a separate data boundary.

scenes.name: Qualify the source
scenes.desc: Source contract checks tick through; acquire, extract, qualify; an amber review branch stops before analysis.

scenes.name: Two observations
scenes.desc: Two fresh captures at least an hour apart confirm a candidate; retry and cached responses sit outside the count.

scenes.name: Analyse, verify, review
scenes.desc: Exact passages flow to analyst, separate verifier and human review; publication is disabled in Preview.

scenes.name: Built to resume
scenes.desc: Run, task, attempt and artifact connect with checkpoints; Compare splits two extractors on the same captured response.

scenes.name: Research tracks
scenes.desc: Three research tracks, all in qualification; 500 policies a day labelled as a target.

scenes.name: Open the evidence
scenes.desc: Three diagram sheets float and align into the research diary and GitHub.

scenes.name: Follow the change
scenes.desc: Official logo hero, then three stationary QR slots with links for the last 15 seconds.
